# Arise Infra: Comprehensive Company Profile

## Overview
Arise Infra is a trusted leader in supplying essential construction materials across Mumbai. We bridge the gap between quality manufacturing and on-site requirements with our robust logistics network and laboratory-tested products.

## Products & Specifications
### Aggregates
- Size Range: 10mm - 40mm
- Features: Low moisture content, optimized for high-strength RCC foundations.
### M-Sand (Manufactured Sand)
- Features: The ideal sustainable alternative to river sand, offering superior concrete bonding and cost-efficiency.
### River Sand
- Features: Clean, organic-impurity-free sand sourced from approved quarries for a smooth, high-quality finish.

## Why Choose Us
- Rigorous Quality Testing: Every batch undergoes IS 383:2016 and IS 650:1991 compliance testing (sieve analysis, chemical composition, silt content).
- Mumbai Logistics Expertise: Our strategic depots and traffic-optimized routing ensure reliable, on-time deliveries even in congested zones.
- Reliability: 15+ years of experience with a 99.5% on-time delivery rate.

## Testimonials
- Rajesh Sharma (Site Engineer, Lodha Group): "Arise Infra's M-Sand quality is exceptional. Their timely delivery to our Worli project helped us maintain our construction schedule."
- Amit Shetty (Contractor, Shetty Constructions): "Their quality testing reports give us confidence for any scale project."
- Priya Kulkarni (Project Manager, Godrej Properties): "Their understanding of Mumbai's requirements makes them our preferred supplier."
